card.what: Size 16 self-tailing winch: a wide base, a bell flaring up into the drum, a black self-tailing ring with ribbed jaws, a polished stripper arm over the jaws and down the side, a glossy black sloped cap with the handle socket set down in it. The plain-top is its own part (winchplain.json)
card.boats: J/22 cabin-top halyard winches (two, Tools/boatkit/layouts/j22.json and the hero script; the class layouts use the small size 6 plain-top there), the fleet boats' sheet winches (Tools/blender/build_fleet.py picks 8 / 16 / 20 / 30 / 40 by base)
card.distance: arm's reach in the cockpit; the camera passes close when a crew member grinds a halyard
card.before: kit Winch16 from bk_parts.winch16 (Oct 2026): a 120 mm black disc base, a plain silver drum and a flat cap with five screws, 97 mm tall: no self-tailer, no stripper arm, 33% short for a size 16

references.use: the look Bean asked for: a modern self-tailer seen from a little above the side, on a dark blue background; outline match by angle (photo_outline.py) and the proportions below
references.url: Bean's upload in the thread 'Improve winch model with reference loop', Nov 8 2026 (measuring and comparing only, not in the repo)

features.text: Wide round base with a straight side, a fine plinth line near the deck and a soft shoulder; no screws showing
A concave bell flaring from the base's shoulder up into the drum
A smooth drum about half the base's diameter, flaring at the top into the lower jaw
Self-tailing jaws: a V groove under a black ring wider than the drum
The ring's outer band ribbed all round, with moulded lettering (made-up TERNWAY, no real brand)
A polished stripper arm: a crescent round the top, an arm over the jaws and down the side, its tip curling in under the ring
A polished handle socket in the middle of a dark top, with a star-shaped hole
Metal base and drum, black self-tailer and top, stainless arm and socket

budget.note: tighter than the loop's usual 20,000: the J/22 carries two and the fleet boats up to four (Windows gates Medium 60 / High 45 fps); build_kit makes the light copy at a quarter
